originalTitle: Dow Jones Futures: Cisco, Coherent Are Earnings Movers Late After Nebius, Lumentum, CoreWeave Lead AI Rally
summary: AI stocks led the market Wednesday, fueled by Nebius, Lumentum, CoreWeave and Super Micro. Cisco and Coherent were earnings movers late.
